r1_d03_sol:
Two issues: (1) `
` is not programmatically associated with the input, and the placeholder cannot serve as its accessible label. (2) `#aaa` text on white has roughly 2.3:1 contrast, below WCAG AA’s 4.5:1 minimum for normal text. Static revision: ```html
``` ```css .note-field { color: #222; background: #fff; } .note-field label { display: block; margin-bottom: .375rem; } .note-field .optional { color: #555; } ``` The optional status is part of the input’s accessible label, and `#555` on white comfortably passes normal-text contrast. The button has no handler or transaction behavior.
